text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: There she is! Quick, get the cameras!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's like a riot in here. Way different
vibes from
other races I've been in.

This is one of the few G1 races for
junior-year
runners. Those who achieve
good results here are
expected to do
well in the years to come.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All eyes on today's field, huh. Then this
is my
chance.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them a performance that will
make them
see me differently.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
For myself... and for everyone hoping for
my
success.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: You don't seem very nervous today.
You don't seem too nervous today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And, like, if you're supposed to be my
trainer,
don't you have anything better
to say?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Go out there and run your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You don't have to tell me that!
